source.title: 《高臣图》秦始皇像
source.identity_basis: The source file identifies Qin Shi Huang; its embedded British Library metadata identifies Or. 11515, f.11v. The catalogue dates the album, not this sitter’s lifetime.

rights.declared_by_file_page: Wikimedia Commons declares PD-Art / PD-old-100-expired and displays a Public Domain Mark. The page qualifies reuse of the photographic reproduction outside the United States.
rights.decision: This release distributes source records and prompts only. It does not assert worldwide public-domain status or relicense the scan under MIT.

reference.coordinate_system: Pixel coordinates in the 1279 × 2000 source image; left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive.
reference.processing: Rectangular crop only; no repainting, retouching or colour adjustment.

lock: Three-quarter head turn toward the viewer’s right
High domed forehead; swept brows with lowered inner ends
Long projecting curved nose with rounded tip
Full cheeks and broad lower face
Small closed pursed mouth under a sideways moustache
Broad fan-shaped beard with separated strands
Source headdress perspective and garment silhouette
forbid: Actor casting or a generic emperor face
Changing the robe into a fantasy black dragon costume

generation.backend_requirement: A hosted image-generation system that accepts an actual reference image.
generation.reproduction_limit: The prompt and source constrain a new interpretation; stochastic image generation is not promised to reproduce the previous pixels.

interpretation_limit: A later portrait, dated with its nineteenth-century album; not a Qin-period likeness. Similarity to this painting cannot verify the historical person’s face.
